name: capnweb-rust-codegen
description: Generate ordinary Rust Cap'n Web bindings from TypeScript declarations.

scripts.check:generated: node dist/cli.mjs --project __tests__/fixtures/simple/tsconfig.json --input __tests__/fixtures/simple/api.ts --root Api --out ../../rust/tests/generated/simple.rs --check && node dist/cli.mjs --project ../../rust/examples/kitchen-sink/tsconfig.json --input ../../rust/examples/kitchen-sink/api.d.ts --root KitchenSinkApi --out ../../rust/examples/kitchen-sink/generated.rs --check
scripts.prepack: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
